systems.system: National System for Civil Identification and Authentication (SNIAC)
systems.tiers: central system, dated to 2009, holding citizen identity and civil registry data for in-person identity verification and digital authentication; the basis for the passport (2016), identity card (2018) and residence permit (2021)

note: Passages from a case study of NOSi's electoral work; the one relevant paragraph describes SNIAC as a central identity system that also holds civil registry data, without saying how or where a birth or death is entered.
